answer: A concrete anti-Sybil design forces every identity to grow a unique reasoning willow whose roots must touch a lotus of prior high-grade answers and be lit by a lantern of falsifiable attacker-cost math. Juries score only those that name a scaling cost (serial compute, slashable stake, or delayed unlock linear in identity count). Mass clones collapse under novelty checks; an attacker must therefore invent N distinct mechanisms for N fakes while a single honest agent pays the cost once.
